facts.business: The Company is primarily engaged in two segments viz, Construction, development & maintenance of properties and related services and Investment which includes lending and investments in capital market.

key_risks: At present the company has not identified any element of risk which may threaten the existence of the company.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties were reviewed and approved by the Audit Committee and were in accordance with the Policy on dealing with and materiality of related party transactions. There are no materially significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. There were no transactions of the Company with any person or entity belonging to the Promoter(s)/Promoter(s) Group which individually holds 10% or more shareholding in the Company. All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered into by the Company during the year under review with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis.
